description: This source file defines the XGlyphTypeface class in the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace. The class encapsulates the properties and methods related to a font face in the PDFsharp library, including font face metadata, font source management, and cache handling for font typefaces in different rendering contexts (GDI, WPF, UWP). The code also contains several constructors and static factory methods for creating instances based on font sources, GDI fonts, WPF typefaces, and font family resolution. It manages font face naming, style, and simulation details, with internal cache and version control mechanisms.

classes.name: XGlyphTypeface
classes.description: Represents a physical font face in PDF processing, encapsulating font metadata, font source, and cached font face objects. Supports creation from various font representations across different platforms and manages internal cache, style simulation, and font identity keys.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFrom
methods.description: Factory method to get or create an XGlyphTypeface based on font family name and resolving options, utilizing internal cache and font resolvers.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromGdi
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an XGlyphTypeface from a GDI+ font object.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromWpf
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an XGlyphTypeface from a WPF Typeface object.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes font metadata properties after constructing an XGlyphTypeface instance.

methods.name: CheckVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the font cache version matches the global font storage version.
